name: Ma Pi Leng Pass
kicker: The high road above the Nho Quế
summary: Ride the rim between Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc when the canyon is the point of the day. UNESCO says the pass rises to 1,200 metres. Mèo Vạc is 24 km from Đồng Văn and takes most of a morning if you stop. The pass is not the town. Stop only where the road allows.
timeNeeded: Most of a morning with the stops
getThere: The road from Đồng Văn toward Mèo Vạc
heroCaption: Tu Sản canyon and the Nho Quế from Mã Pì Lèng, the road on the rim
gettingThere: The loop page puts Mã Pì Lèng in Mèo Vạc district, on the road out of Đồng Văn. UNESCO says the pass rises to 1,200 metres. That figure is the pass. GeoNames gives the former town seat about 107 metres on SRTM3 and 115 metres on ASTER. Do not use the pass as the town.
Mèo Vạc is 24 km from Đồng Văn and takes most of a morning if the stops are made. A separate pass-only duration is Check on arrival. Stop only where the road allows. Do not ride it after dark.

The canyon under the rim is Tu Sản and the Nho Quế. UNESCO says 700–800 metres and one of Southeast Asia’s deepest. The culture page says 800-metre cliffs and the deepest gorge in Southeast Asia. Both stay. Side road 193A is the closer look. A boat or a kayak is named for June, when the river is full. The boat fee and the time on the water are Check on arrival. The sky path is a separate walk: 500 metres and about two hours through Flower Hmong villages. The adventures page says Happiness Road took 1,300 volunteers seven years. The buckwheat feature says the road began in the late 1950s and took over seven years, without the volunteer count. Both stay. The sky-path fee is Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Dong Van
legs.body: Toward Mèo Vạc. 24 km, most of a morning with the stops. Daylight only.

legs.heading: From Ha Giang town
legs.body: The pass is the road after Đồng Văn, not the start of the loop. QL4C reaches Đồng Văn first. The town elevations and the 1,200-metre pass are different places.

admissionNote: The fee is Check on arrival. The boat fee and the sky-path fee are Check on arrival.
